notes.title: Update for Truth Beneath the Shadows Version 1.0.1!
notes.notes:
[p]Great news! [b]Truth Beneath the Shadows[/b] has been updated to [b]version 1.0.1[/b], now featuring [b]100% English localization[/b] for all narrative content [/p][p]However, some [b]UI elements and commands still appear in Thai[/b] due to minor technical constraints. notes.title: Thai Update:
notes.notes:
Thai Update: Our team will soon be working on fixing and improving the Thai text in certain scenes of the game to ensure correct spelling and grammar. This update is aimed at providing everyone with a smoother and more enjoyable gameplay experience. We sincerely thank you for all your suggestions and the patience you’ve shown us.

For the English Version: At this time, we do not plan to make further improvements or corrections to the English text, as we have designed and are confident in its current format. Therefore, there will be no changes to the English text in the foreseeable future. Please be assured that we are focusing on enhancing the quality of the Thai version first. Should any changes be made to the English text in the future, we will be sure to announce them.

notes.title: Announcement Tale of Ren Demo Version 1.08 is Now Available on Steam!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce that Tale of Ren: Demo Version 1.08 has been successfully updated and is now available for you to try on Steam! 
This Version 1.08 will be the final demo version we’re releasing before the full game, which is set to be released very soon. The systems and mechanics in this demo are identical to those in the full version, giving you the chance to experience the game at its fullest before anyone else.
We’ve improved the game, added new content, and optimized the systems for a smoother and more enjoyable experience. Dive back into the world of Ren and let us know your thoughts!
Thank you so much for your support and patience—we hope you enjoy the game
